name: Wegerzyn Gardens
shortDescription: Flowers everywhere, arbors, and little hidden pockets around every corner — plus a few surprises tucked in just for the little ones.
bestFor: Anyone who wants color and structure, and families with young children who do better when there's something to discover.
restrooms: Yes — an accessible restroom inside the Children's Discovery Garden during garden hours, plus a portable restroom at the south end of the parking lot.
seasonalNote: Late spring through late summer is when this one is at its best.
